title: Doty's alien crystal that showed the crucifixion

tellings.quote: Now Richard Dodie tells the story. The most amazing thing he ever saw in the military. It was a crystal.

plain: A former Air Force counterintelligence agent named Richard Doty says the most amazing thing he ever saw in the military was an alien crystal that showed scenes of the crucifixion of Jesus. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron passes the story on to Michels as something Doty tells. If true, it would mean such an object holds a record of events in human religious history.
